log: Shard Deck: PLAYER Cleric/Warrior; AI Warrior/Mage. Each Shard Deck starts at 12 cards. After the Opening Coin Flip, each side draws its 6-card Opening Hand first, then 3 Starting Shards into its Shard Pool. Mana Regen starts at +1.
